about: The version in the app's User-Agent token (DynodocApp/<version> (<kind>)). ONE grammar: <major>.<minor>.<patch>, each one to nine ASCII digits. A producer takes the leading dotted triple of its own version and drops whatever follows; with no such triple it writes 0.0.0. Run by signin.rs (Rust), AppTokenTest.kt (Kotlin) and src/lib/app-signin.test.ts (the web app that reads the token). Each test also generates two long cases itself: '1.2.3-' followed by 5000 'x' gives 1.2.3, and 400 digits followed by '.0.0' gives 0.0.0. Keep one case per line: the Kotlin test reads this file with a regular expression.
